quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #20
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: A driver entering interstate traffic from an entrance or acceleration ramp should:

options.text: Yield to drivers already on the interstate.
Expect other drivers to change lanes for them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to drivers already on the interstate.
questions.explanation: When entering interstate traffic from an entrance or acceleration ramp, yield to drivers already on the highway. Merge into traffic safely when there is space.

questions.question: You are stopped in line at a stop sign. After the vehicles ahead pass through with no cross traffic, you:

options.text: May go through without stopping again.
Must stop again at the stop sign before proceeding.
May slowly roll past the stop sign.
May follow the vehicle ahead without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must stop again at the stop sign before proceeding.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop at the stop sign and check for traffic before proceeding. Do not skip this step even if other traffic is moving.

questions.question: Round signs warn drivers about:
questions.correctAnswerText: Upcoming railroad crossings.
questions.explanation: Round signs alert drivers to upcoming railroad crossings. Use extra caution when you see these signs.

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway, you should:

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check that the passing lane is clear and signal your intention to change lanes.

questions.question: When driving on wet pavement, remember:

options.text: Roads are extra slippery right after rain starts.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery, especially right after it starts raining. Water can cause your tires to lose grip. Slow down and leave extra distance between you and other vehicles.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.correctAnswerText: Yield
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and cross traffic go first. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: Hydroplaning is usually caused by:
questions.correctAnswerText: Excessive speed.
questions.explanation: When you drive too fast on wet roads, your tires cannot clear water effectively. They lose grip and slide on the water film. This is hydroplaning.

questions.question: Fluorescent yellow-green signs warn about:
questions.correctAnswerText: School zones.
questions.explanation: Fluorescent yellow-green signs mark pedestrian, bicycle, and school areas. Drive carefully when you see these signs.

questions.question: You may cross a dashed white line:

options.text: When it is safe to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is safe to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Dashed white lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. You may cross them to change lanes if it is safe.

questions.question: A stop sign is shaped like:
questions.correctAnswerText: An octagon.
questions.explanation: Stop signs are eight-sided. This unique shape tells drivers to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: Where should you keep a space cushion around your vehicle?

options.text: Only on the left and right sides of your vehicle.
Only in front of your vehicle.
On all sides of your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: On all sides of your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Keep space around all sides of your vehicle so you have time to react to dangers. Do not drive too close to vehicles on your left or right.

questions.question: What should you do when an emergency vehicle with flashing lights is near you?

options.text: Speed up to get out of the way.
Stop your vehicle right away and block their path.
Do everything you can to clear a path for the emergency vehicle.
Signal to the emergency vehicle when it is safe for them to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do everything you can to clear a path for the emergency vehicle.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle has flashing lights, you must help clear its path. If it is safe, pull to the side of the road to let the vehicle pass.

questions.question: What does a red arrow on a traffic light mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly through the intersection.
You must stop, then go when the way is clear.
You must stop and wait for a green light or green arrow.
You may turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must stop and wait for a green light or green arrow.
questions.explanation: A red arrow means you must come to a full stop. Stay stopped until a green light or green arrow appears, unless a sign says otherwise.

questions.question: What does an octagonal (8-sided) sign always mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: All octagonal signs are stop signs. Come to a complete stop at every red, 8-sided sign.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing red traffic light?

options.text: Go through if there is no other traffic.
Keep going because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Flashing red lights are used at dangerous intersections. You must treat them the same as stop signs.

questions.question: When a traffic light turns green, what should you do?

options.text: Speed up as fast as you can.
Wait for another driver to signal you to go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let pedestrians cross first.
questions.explanation: A green light means you can go. But first, let any pedestrians or other traffic in the intersection cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing.
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What happens when you take drugs and alcohol together?

options.text: You are more likely to crash.
It is just as dangerous as alcohol alone.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are more likely to crash.
questions.explanation: Drugs (illegal, prescription, or over-the-counter) can harm your brain and make driving unsafe. Mixing drugs with alcohol greatly increases your crash risk.

questions.question: What do diagonal stripes sloping down and to the right on a barricade mean?

options.text: You should move to the right.
You should move to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You should move to the right.
questions.explanation: Diagonal stripes on a barricade guide drivers. Stripes sloping down and to the right mean move right. Stripes sloping down and to the left mean move left.

questions.question: What does a defensive driver do?
questions.correctAnswerText: Watches what other drivers do.
questions.explanation: A defensive driver watches for what other drivers might do and thinks ahead about possible problems.

questions.question: What is a good rule for passing other vehicles?

options.text: Pass on the right whenever possible.
Drive with traffic flow and pass only when necessary.
Move to the front of slow traffic so you can see better.
Always flash your lights and use your horn to warn other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with traffic flow and pass only when necessary.
questions.explanation: Passing another vehicle increases the risk of a crash. If you drive faster than others, you will need to keep passing. Drive at the same speed as traffic, follow the speed limit, and pass only when you need to.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spots?

options.text: Turn your head and look over your shoulders.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulders.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas around your car that mirrors cannot show. Check them by turning your head and looking over your shoulders.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic.
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive so slowly that you interrupt traffic flow. You can get a ticket for driving too slowly.

questions.question: Where is passing prohibited?
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Passing is illegal and unsafe on hills, curves, at intersections, and at railroad crossings.

questions.question: If you need to slow down on a slippery road, what should you do first?

options.text: Take your foot off the gas pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take your foot off the gas pedal.
questions.explanation: First, take your foot off the gas pedal to slow down on a slippery road. If you need to slow down more, gently press the brake pedal with steady, light pressure.
